intro: Hello! I am Princess Pippa, and this is Bobo. The Queen is having a party. Will you help us get there?
scene-river: Oh no, a river! Bobo thinks we need something. Make a word with the magic gems.
scene-gate: Oh dear, a hungry goat! Bobo thinks the goat wants something. Make a word with the magic gems.
scene-cave: It is so dark in this cave! Bobo thinks we need something. Make a word with the magic gems.
slide: Slide your finger along the wand.
hint-drag: Pick up a gem and put it on the wand.
word-but-goat: That is a word, but the goat is still hungry!
word-but-river: That is a word, but we still cannot cross the river!
solve-log: A log! Now we can walk over the river.
solve-bun: Yum! The goat loves the bun. The gate is open!
solve-jam: Yum! The goat loves the jam. The gate is open!
solve-sun: The sun! Now the cave is bright. Look, a friendly bat! Let's go to the castle.
fx-cat: A cat! The cat wants to come with us.
fx-cot: A cot! Bobo has a little nap.
fx-cog: A cog! Look, it spins round and round.
fx-lot: A lot of stones! Clack, clack!
fx-hut: A tiny hut! Bobo peeks inside.
fx-nut: A nut! Bobo eats it up. Yum!
party-arrive: Hooray! We are at the Queen's party!
queen-thanks: Thank you, Pippa. And thank you, Emma!
sticker: Here is a crown sticker for your sticker book!
play-again: Do you want to play again?
